core_obligations: Factor the diagonal: the diagonal of the composite is the composite of the graph of the first morphism with the comparison morphism between the two fibre products (proof lines 858-866)

Property of the factors: the comparison morphism has the required property by the corresponding result on fibre products after a change of base, and the graph is a base change of the diagonal of the first morphism (proof lines 867-871)

Conclude by composition permanence for the corresponding property of morphisms of algebraic spaces, which gives the property for the composite diagonal and hence the separation axiom for the composite (proof lines 872-884)
proof_roadmap: Δ_{X/Z} 分解为 X → X ×_Y X → X ×_Z X。
第二支由「映射后的纤维积」引理具有所需性质 P；第一支是 Δ_{X/Y} 的基变换，也有 P。
由代数空间层面 P 的复合保持性，Δ_{X/Z} 有 P ⇒ 复合态射满足相应分离公理。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that all the separation axioms for morphisms of algebraic stacks are stable under composition (author lemma at source lines 851-856, label lemma-composition-separated). The proof (source lines 858-885) factors the diagonal of the composite through the fibre product over the middle stack, obtains the property for the two factors from the fibre product result and base change, and concludes by composition permanence for the underlying property of algebraic spaces (proof lines 858-884). The factorization of the diagonal is the substance. H3.
